authoring.author: claude (kinkerstraat odd-faces lane)
authoring.note: Kinkerstraat 31-49 (odd side, Bilderdijkkade to Da Costakade), 1885-1893. Eight plain-brick fronts of one row (33-47: 3 axes, flat heads under white keystones, pediment dormers with zinc finials), 31 black-painted with 2 axes and no dormer, and the 1893 corner 49 with white speklagen and blocked relieving arches (kinker-1886-neo-renaissance). Shops read on zoom crops of the 2024-12-11 strip. #98 pass: Kinkerstraat 47 drew #dcbb9d through its measured tint (photo #bf9d83, too light and saturated); it takes the brick of 45 (#c9a080, the same sunlit red brick on the strip) through the city tint instead. Brick facings (overrides.palette) moved to paletteOverrides: the 3 cm facing lay 1 cm off the shop doors (coplanar).

limitations: Kinkerstraat 33: plain flat-topped box dormer with a white frame drawn as the type pediment dormer (plain-brick has no plain-dormer crown).
Kinkerstraat 49: centre brick wall dormer with a flat cap between two small dormers; not drawn (neo-renaissance has no wall-dormer crown).
Iron wall anchors; tall carved keystones drawn as plain keystone blocks.
